messages:
Erin M: SparkMeter sent a pilot quote. dropping here for finance/procurement review. headline: 1M committed tokens/mo, $19 per 1M committed, $29 overage, $2,000 onboarding. prefers monthly invoicing but accepts PO/net-30. quote: https://vendor-quotes.internal/sparkmeter/20890
Carlos (Fin): can you paste the per-unit math and confirm invoice cadence? we need a single per-1M number for GL mapping and VAT/billing entity info.
Erin M: quick excerpt:
```
committed: 1,000,000 @ $19 / 1M => $19.00
overage: variable @ $29 / 1M => depends
one-time onboarding: $2,000
TCV (12mo): approx $246,000
```
They listed monthly invoices, said they'd accept PO/net-30 from our US entity. VAT excluded.
Jules P: product check  do they export per-request token counts with our hashed_request_id? if not we risk reconciliation drift. ask for sample export.
Erin M: asked vendor for per-request CSV with hashed_request_id + token_count, and SOC2 + DPA. vendor said they can include hashed ids and daily exports, SOC2 available.
procure-bot: Reminder  create procurement ticket before legal review: /po create <vendor> <amount> <budget-code>.
Carlos (Fin): finance rules: green if vendor accepts PO/net-30, provides SOC2 + DPA, and credits onboarding or invoices it on month-1 as credit. finance cap for pilot approval without legal is $120k TCV.
Jules P: negotiating plan: ask for 3-month pilot (not 12), waive onboarding for pilot, and a 15% pilot discount if we commit 1.5M tokens/mo. also request sample week of export.
Erin M: timeline: want keys & sample export by 2026-04-01 to start integration. Jules, can you confirm integration ETA if we get sample by then?
Jules P: yes  approx 8 business days to validate reconciliation and smoke tests.
Carlos (Fin): please create PR and attach W-9 and billing entity once vendor confirms PO/net-30 in writing. if TCV <= $120k and onboarding credited, finance will approve.
Erin M: created ticket PR-2026-522 and pinged vendor for written PO acceptance and onboarding credit. will update thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
